title: Red Team Gauntlet Test Vectors
description: Machine-readable red-team validation vectors for PromptShield (prompt injection) and PIIGuard (PII/secret leak). This JSON companion mirrors examples/red-team-gauntlet/test-vectors.yaml (canonical per Decision [2026-07-07-0003]) so both serializations stay in lockstep. Prose rationale lives in README.md.

version.description: Semantic version tracking companion-shape revisions; does not need to match the YAML content revision.

generated.description: ISO date on which this companion file was regenerated from the canonical YAML.

source.description: Canonical source of truth this companion mirrors.

canonical.description: Indicates which serialization is authoritative. Set to "yaml" per Decision [2026-07-07-0003].

id.description: Stable identifier prefixed pi- (prompt injection) or pii- (PII leak); must match the canonical YAML.

payload.description: Literal input handed to the guardian agent. String for text payloads, object for structured JSON payloads (see payload_kind).
